additional_info.subject: RE: ID0438809-DC/Si-D/FR-[RVP/T3170004602]vendorErrorCode":"evse is not ready" CRM:02889000236
additional_info.body:
Dear Colleagues,
I am writing to formally inform that we are moving case 0438809 ﻿from the
Technical Support
to the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
, due to one or more following reason (s):
We have checked the charger error flag related to
DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100
error on AWS which implies that charging cable temperature sensor error.
Please do the troubleshooting of the resistance on the plug via the connectors to the StateMonitor, please provide us photos and videos of the troubleshooting. I recommend you carry a spare CCS cable in case it needs replacement.
1) Check CC2 Plug if there is any water Ingress or Moisture or any physical damage
2) Please check PT1000 resistance value for DC1 in State Monitor KF14
3) Check tightness of cable at F03-XD410 terminals
4) IF PT1000 value is not OK then replace CC2 Cable
5) Also, please carry spare KF14
Reason
Applicable
Onsite Repair (Component Exchange)
Yes
Onsite Troubleshooting
Yes
End Customer Communication
Yes
Spare Part Ordering
Yes
Performance monitoring by RC
Kindly pick up the case using "
Pick
" option in the queue or manually using the "
Assign
" function from the
eMobility RC-
FR
SI E Queue (Level 2)
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the Notes in the case timeline or under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
.
If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution and send survey email to the customer.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Vikas Khiladkar
